## Context
Relation-scoped unlink was added to the core, public library, and CLI, and MCP parity is tracked by airy-starchy-muntjac. Two maintained documentation surfaces still state the pre-change contract: `docs/ticket-model.md` says `unlink <source> <target>` takes no relation argument, and `src/rebar/_cli/help/overview.txt` says unlink has no relation arg. This contradicts the current optional relation accepted by `rebar.unlink` and `rebar unlink`. The Phase 1 sibling sweep also found the same obsolete operation wording in `docs/event-schema.md`; its event-shape description must distinguish the relation selector from the emitted link-UUID cancellation.

## Plan
- Add a held-out contract test through the real packaged top-level CLI help and maintained public documentation surfaces.
- Update the ticket-model and packaged overview surfaces to document `unlink <source> <target> [relation]`.
- Preserve and explain the omitted-relation most-recent fallback.
- State that an explicit canonical relation removes exactly that relation while preserving other active relations on the pair.
- Correct the event-schema operation wording while preserving the true event payload semantics.
- Regenerate any derived guide/reference output if these sources feed one.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The ticket-model unlink section documents the optional relation argument.
- [x] The packaged CLI overview documents the optional relation argument through real `rebar --help` output.
- [x] Both surfaces preserve the omitted-selector most-recent fallback contract.
- [x] Both surfaces describe exact relation-scoped removal.
- [x] The event schema distinguishes optional operation selection from UUID-targeted UNLINK event cancellation.
- [x] Documentation drift and relevant help tests pass.
